headline: Fair Isaac Corporation (NYSE:FICO) Misses Q2 CY2026 Revenue Estimates, Stock Drops
summary: Credit scoring and analytics company FICO (NYSE:FICO) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales rose 25.7% year on year to $674.2 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $2.53 billion at the midpoint came in 0.9% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $12.18 per share was 3.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
